name: Uralmashzavod
note: Listed as a sponsor of HC Avtomobilist on the club's sponsors page (archived 8 July 2025). Ultimate owner not established: 51% of parent UK UZTM-Kartex passed to JSC Enlil Finance in March 2022 and Enlil's shareholders are not public; 48.6% is held by the closed fund ZPIF 'Gazprombank - industrial investments'. A Russian court convicted an Uralmashzavod workshop chief in June 2026 over a worker's death at the plant (TASS) - flagged for maintainers, not recorded as a claim.
